title: C-DIT Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
organization: Centre for Development of Imaging Technology
summary: C-DIT is hiring a Consultant (Fund Realisation) for its Finance & Accounts Department, exclusively for retired Government officials. The selected candidate will engage for an initial period of one year with a monthly salary ranging between Rs.40,000 and Rs.50,000. Applications must be submitted by 08.12.2026 via physical format or email.
qualification: Graduate in any discipline with good experience in financial management, including debt recovery and recovery of Government dues.
location: Client offices/project sites in the State of Kerala
summary_hindi: सी-डिट की फाइनेंस एवं अकाउंट्स विभाग में एक कंसल्टेंट (फंड रियालाइजेशन) की भर्ती की जा रही है, जो केवल सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी अधिकारियों के लिए है। चयनित उम्मीदवार को प्रारंभिक रूप से एक साल के लिए 40,000 से 50,000 रुपये प्रति माह के वेतन पर नियुक्त किया जाएगा। आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि 08.12.2026 है, और आवेदन भौतिक प्रारूप या ई-मेल के माध्यम से जमा किए जाने चाहिए।
selection_process: Shortlisting based on biodata and experience
how_to_apply: Fill in the application with required details.
Attach copies of certificates proving qualifications and experience.
Send the application either by post to The Registrar, C-DIT, or email to hr@cdit.org before the deadline.
Ensure that the application is complete to avoid rejection.
overview: The engagement of a Consultant (Fund Realisation) at C-DIT involves managing financial operations, specifically focusing on debt recovery and ensuring timely realisation of funds from various projects. This role is particularly well-suited for retired government officials with a robust background in finance, especially those who have experience in liaising with government departments.

This position not only allows the selected candidate to utilize their extensive skills and experience in a meaningful way, but also contributes to the efficient functioning of C-DIT, which plays a vital role in the state's IT and governance initiatives. The temporary engagement provides a unique opportunity to impact public sector financial management directly.

Before applying, candidates must verify their eligibility, particularly regarding retirement status and qualifications, as this recruitment is exclusively for retired officials. Prospective applicants should also ensure they understand the nature of the temporary role and the lack of promise for future permanent employment.
about_organization: The Centre for Development of Imaging Technology (C-DIT) is an autonomous institution set up by the Government of Kerala, focusing on IT initiatives and projects. With a commitment to digital transformation in government services, C-DIT provides consulting and technical support, undertaking various projects in e-governance and web development.
eligibility_notes: Applicants must be retired Government officials from the Finance Department of Kerala or from public sector financial institutions within the state. Graduation in any discipline and substantial experience in financial management are mandatory. No age relaxation is provided, and candidates must be below 65 years at the time of application.
preparation_tips: Brush up on financial management principles, particularly debt recovery practices.
Familiarize yourself with the processes of the Finance Department of Kerala and its procedures.
Review past experiences that showcase communication and negotiation skills with government departments.
Prepare for potential interview questions regarding previous roles and responsibilities in financial management.

faq.q: How many vacancies are there in C-DIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.a: There is one position for Consultant (Fund Realisation). The number may vary based on requirements.

faq.q: What is the last date to apply for C-DIT Consultant (Fund Realisation)?
faq.a: The last date is 08.12.2026, Tuesday, 5 pm.

faq.q: What is the qualification for C-DIT Consultant (Fund Realisation)?
faq.a: Applicants must be retired officials with a graduate degree and relevant experience in financial management.
Candidates must be below 65 years on the date of notification. Engagement will not be available for those who turn 65.

faq.q: What is the remuneration for this post?
faq.a: The monthly consolidated remuneration ranges between Rs.40,000 and Rs.50,000, depending on qualifications.
